newsitem.title: USA: Municipal sales to total $2 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal sales to total $2 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $2 billion in 41 offerings for Wednesday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $499 million in 20 issues. The largest issue is a $165 million Metro Atlanta Rapid Transit Agnecy deal at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $1.5 billion in 21 offerings. The largest is a $579 million Municipal Assistance Corp for the City of New York deal through Morgan Stanley & Co.
An additional $180 million of negotiated deals in six offerings are on the possible sales calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price them Wednesday depending on market conditions.
